tax_year.rationale: CalendarYr directly maps to the calendar/tax year printed at the top of the form.

corrected.rationale: CorrectedInd maps to the CORRECTED checkbox on the form.

filer_name.rationale: BusinessNameLine1Txt under PayerName is the primary filer/payer name line; however the blueprint bundles the full name into one field while canonical splits into Line1 and Line2 — blueprint should split into filer_name_line1 and filer_name_line2.

filer_address.rationale: Blueprint bundles street address into one string; canonical PayerUSAddress splits into AddressLine1Txt, CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, ZIPCd — blueprint should split into separate fields.

filer_city_state_zip.rationale: Blueprint bundles city/state/ZIP into one string; canonical PayerUSAddress splits these into separate child elements — blueprint should split into CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, and ZIPCd fields.

filer_phone.rationale: PhoneNum at the root level corresponds to the filer/payer telephone number printed in the filer address block.

filer_tin.rationale: PayerEIN maps to the filer's taxpayer identification number box on the form.

payee_name.rationale: RecipientNm directly maps to the payee's name box on the form.

payee_address.rationale: Blueprint bundles payee street address into one string; canonical RecipientUSAddress splits into AddressLine1Txt, CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, ZIPCd — blueprint should split into separate fields.

payee_city_state_zip.rationale: Blueprint bundles city/state/ZIP into one string; canonical RecipientUSAddress splits these into separate child elements — blueprint should split into CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, and ZIPCd fields.

payee_tin.rationale: RecipientSSN maps to the payee's TIN (SSN or EIN) box on the form; note RecipientEIN is also a candidate but RecipientSSN is the primary element here.

account_number.rationale: RecipientAccountNum maps to the Account number box assigned by the filer to identify the payee's account.

gross_amount.rationale: GrossAmt maps to Box 1a — Gross amount of total reportable payment transactions.

card_not_present_transactions.rationale: CardNotPresentTransAmt maps to Box 1b — Gross amount for card-not-present transactions.

merchant_category_code.rationale: MerchantCategoryCd maps to Box 2 — the four-digit Merchant Category Code.

number_of_transactions.rationale: PaymentTransactionCnt maps to Box 3 — total number of payment transactions.

federal_income_tax_withheld.rationale: FederalIncomeTaxWithheldAmt maps to Box 4 — federal income tax withheld under backup withholding.

january_amount.rationale: JanuaryAmt maps to Box 4a — gross amount of transactions for January.

february_amount.rationale: FebruaryAmt maps to Box 4b — gross amount of transactions for February.

march_amount.rationale: MarchAmt maps to Box 4c — gross amount of transactions for March.

april_amount.rationale: AprilAmt maps to Box 4d — gross amount of transactions for April.

may_amount.rationale: MayAmt maps to Box 4e — gross amount of transactions for May.

june_amount.rationale: JuneAmt maps to Box 4f — gross amount of transactions for June.

july_amount.rationale: JulyAmt maps to Box 4g — gross amount of transactions for July.

august_amount.rationale: AugustAmt maps to Box 4h — gross amount of transactions for August.

september_amount.rationale: SeptemberAmt maps to Box 4i — gross amount of transactions for September.

october_amount.rationale: OctoberAmt maps to Box 4j — gross amount of transactions for October.

november_amount.rationale: NovemberAmt maps to Box 4k — gross amount of transactions for November.

december_amount.rationale: DecemberAmt maps to Box 4l — gross amount of transactions for December.

payment_card_transactions.rationale: PaymentCardInd maps to the payment card transactions checkbox on the form.

third_party_network_transactions.rationale: ThirdPartyNetworkInd maps to the third-party network transactions checkbox on the form.

pse_name.rationale: PSENm maps to the PSE name box identifying the Payment Settlement Entity or EPF.

pse_phone.rationale: PSEPhoneNum maps to the telephone number printed adjacent to the PSE name box.

state.rationale: StateAbbreviationCd under Form1099KStateLocalTaxGrp maps to the first state abbreviation in the state information section.

state_identification_number.rationale: StateIdNum under Form1099KStateLocalTaxGrp maps to the filer's state identification number for the first state.

state_tax_withheld.rationale: StateTaxWithheldAmt under Form1099KStateLocalTaxGrp maps to the state income tax withheld for the first state.

state_2.rationale: The canonical schema uses a repeating Form1099KStateLocalTaxGrp group rather than separate first/second state elements; blueprint should refactor to reference the second occurrence of the group rather than a distinct state_2 field.

state_identification_number_2.rationale: The canonical schema uses a repeating Form1099KStateLocalTaxGrp group for multiple states; blueprint should refactor to reference the second group occurrence instead of a flat state_identification_number_2 field.

state_tax_withheld_2.rationale: The canonical schema uses a repeating Form1099KStateLocalTaxGrp group for multiple states; blueprint should refactor to reference the second group occurrence instead of a flat state_tax_withheld_2 field.
